pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal patches with rounded vertices and softened pixel-level edge gradients. Individual dark regions are large and irregularly shaped on the mid-flank, becoming smaller and more densely clustered near the dorsal and ventral transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light interstitial pathways with high topological connectivity. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent, narrow pixel thickness across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the out-of-focus background, transitioning to a more compressed profile over the shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Small, discrete hyper-pigmented spots are visible on the upper shoulder and upper flank, contrasting with the lighter interstitial corridors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of approximately 3-5 small, dark, localized nodules or lesions is visible on the lower-middle flank. A large, dark, indistinct hyper-pigmented region is present on the lower visible portion of the hind limb.
